name: Ada County, ID
findings: Ada County has 1,867 nonprofit organizations. 860 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 697 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Ada County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Health care organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 34 health care organizations here list public events, compared with about 12 in similar places of this size.
